subject: Lucent Health — vendor onboarding & invoice submission method
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Cho <susan.cho@lucenthealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lucent Health — vendor onboarding & invoice submission method

Hi Susan — thanks again for taking the call earlier. Two quick asks so we can finish vendor activation on our side: 

1) Preferred invoice channel: we recommend portal-first (secure upload + automated parsing) with an email fallback for the first 30 days of go-live. Can you confirm whether your AP team can use a portal link, or if you require invoices to arrive via SMTP/SFTP?

2) Minimal required fields: PO number, remit entity name, invoice date, total amount, tax id (if applicable), and a single-line description per line item. If Lucent needs PDFs with the PO rendered on page 1, tell us now so we can align parsing rules.

Attached: redwood_sample_invoice_template.csv (CSV header + lineitem example) and vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (AP contact + remit entity dropdown).

Our recommendation rationale (quick): portal = faster onboarding, auto-acks with invoice id, better duplicate detection; email = ok as a temporary fallback but needs a subject token so we can auto-route and reconcile POs. Suggested subject token for fallback: RH-PO-{PO_NUMBER} (e.g., RH-PO-CH-12345).

Next step: please reply with your channel preference + whether Lucent requires PDF-as-primary or CSV/lineitem attachment support. If you prefer portal, we can provision sandbox access within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142

From: Susan Cho <susan.cho@lucenthealth.com>

Cc: payments@lucenthealth.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:39:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Lucent Health — vendor onboarding & invoice submission method

Camila — thanks, appreciate the clear options. A few clarifications from AP: 

- Our current ERP expects a PDF invoice per invoice (single PDF per invoice) with the PO number clearly visible on page 1. We can accept a CSV for lineitem imports in special cases but prefer PDFs.
- We do not have immediate access to your portal; SFTP is our standard for a number of vendors. Can your portal export a single packaged PDF after upload, or is there an SFTP bridge available?
- We often have invoices that reference multiple PO numbers on a single invoice PDF. Does your portal support multiple-PO mapping per file?

Attaching an anonymized example: lucent_invoice_example.pdf (shows our typical header + PO placement).

If portal requires changes on our side, we can consider email fallback but want to minimize manual processing.

Best,
Susan Cho
Director, AP Operations — Lucent Health
susan.cho@lucenthealth.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lucent Health — vendor onboarding & invoice submission method

Thanks for the example, Susan — that helps. Quick responses inline and a proposed path forward: 

- PDF-first is fine: our portal accepts PDFs and will extract the PO when it is rendered on page 1. We also support multi-PO mapping: if a PDF contains multiple POs, the portal will create one invoice envelope referencing all detected PO numbers and will attempt lineitem reconciliation per PO (exceptions flagged to AP).

- SFTP bridge: we can support SFTP pickup as an option, but it requires a bit more ops coordination and is slower to validate during pilot. If SFTP is required, we can route files from your SFTP to our ingestion pipeline and still apply the same PO parsing rules.

Options (recommended):
- Portal (preferred): secure upload + immediate automated ack and invoice id. Auto-parse rules: look for PO on page 1; fallback to subject token if PO isn't found. Sample behavior: portal returns an ack JSON with invoice_id and detected_po_list.
- Email fallback (30-day temporary): SMTP to payments@redwood-invoices.redwoodinference.com with subject token RH-PO-{PO_NUMBER} and either PDF attached or a single CSV attachment with line items. For emails without subject token, we will ingest as manual exception queue.

Minimal CSV/lineitem header we accept (attached portal_lineitem_spec.csv): PO, invoice_number, invoice_date, line_number, description, qty, unit_price, line_total, tax_amount, remit_entity. If you go CSV route, please follow those headers exactly.

Attached: portal_lineitem_spec.csv, ack-example.json (simulated portal ack).

Ask: Can Lucent confirm either (A) portal sandbox access this week so we can test with lucent_invoice_example.pdf, or (B) if you need SFTP we will set a short ops runbook and timeline. If neither, we'll proceed with email fallback subject token to avoid a manual queue.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min call to walk the sample through the sandbox.

Camila Reyes
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Lucent Health — vendor onboarding & invoice submission method

Thanks everyone — agree with the portal-first approach. Camila, please provision sandbox access for Lucent today and include the sample ack flow and parsing logs in the sandbox workspace. Susan — Lucent can go portal-first; for an expedited go-live we will accept the email fallback for the first 30 days under these conditions: 

1) Subject token required: RH-PO-{PO_NUMBER} (exact literal prefix RH-PO-). This allows auto-route and reduces manual queueing.
2) PDF preferred: if you attach a PDF, ensure PO is on page 1. If you must send a CSV, follow the portal_lineitem_spec.csv header exactly.
3) Multiple-PO invoices are supported; we will ingest them as a multi-PO envelope and will surface any lineitem mismatches back to Lucent via the portal ticket.

Camila/Vanessa — please share sandbox url + one test account for payments@lucenthealth.com and confirm SFTP runbook if Susan's team still prefers that route. Susan — if you can confirm preferred channel by end of day Thursday (2027-04-22), we'll aim for provisioning and a test ingest the following week.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
